proof_review: Independent expansion modulo D_B: U=Q_B*v and N_Bj=Q_B*a_Bj. For dot and cross, beta(Q_B*v,Q_B*a)=D_B^2*beta(v,a). Thus D_B divides beta(U,N_Bj).
General U,N each degree<=3; reduced beta(U,NA)-D_A*(beta(U,NB)/D_B) degree<=6. Rigid U degree<=2 gives <=5.
u_B=0 independently gives degree<=4; positive D_B ensures no real root/sign change.
Inverse theta requires symmetric E and a specified arcsin branch; area-center translation correction has correct sign.
Three noncollinear point pairs yield exactly affine-fit zero residual; does not certify physical trajectory.
limitations: Historical frozen 1810-step affine data is reaggregated, not recomputed on INT1 source.
Finite polynomial probe is support; acceptance rests on symbolic factor/divisibility reasoning, not sampling.
restart_protocol: All data reread from scratch after restart; no partial output resumed. Prior unpublished link-regex check was invalidated because it parsed code-form matrix multiplication as a hyperlink.
